known_limitations: Proposal-only blind lane: no code, no backtest, no scored/smoke/novelty numbers consumed or produced; all thresholds (tau1=0.10pp, tau2=0.15pp, |z|>=1.0, H=5) are blind frozen priors, explicitly not tuned.

Feasibility decision-day counts (GB 84, CA 84, AU 22, NZ 27, US 85 = 302 events, 557 pair-decisions pre-threshold) were computed on a Mon-Fri approximation of the FX grid from census timing fields only; the exact FX trading calendar is owned by the staged spot series and must be re-measured at P2/D2 (Q-6 recent-window floor applies).

Cơ chế được khai báo đúng là late-window drift; làn này KHÔNG quan sát được reaction tại publication instant.
FX spot daily 16:00-NY series và Q-8 cost constants là DECLARED DEPENDENCIES (P1/D2 thẩm quyền; Q-8 NOT_YET_MEASURED => cost verdict fail-closed NOT_RUN nếu P1 chưa publish).
